# Lotka-Volterra competition {#sec-lv-compet}

{{< include ../preamble.qmd >}}

## Concepts and intuitions {.unnumbered}

## Formal {.unnumbered}

$$
    \left\{
    \begin{aligned}
    \frac{d n_1}{dt} = r_1 n_1(1 - \frac{\alpha_{11} n_1 + \alpha_{12} n_2 }{K_1}) \\
    \frac{d n_2}{dt} = r_2 n_2(1 - \frac{\alpha_{22} n_2 + \alpha_{21} n_1 }{K_2})
    \end{aligned}
    \right.
$${#eq-lotka-volterra-competition}

## Examples {.unnumbered}

```{r}
#| code-fold: false
#| fig-cap: "Lotka-Volterra predator-prey system showing stable limit cycle"
#| label: fig-lotka-volterra-sim

library(deSolve)

# Function to define Lotka-Volterra ODE system
lotka_volterra <- function(t, state, parms) {
  n1 <- state["n1"]
  n2 <- state["n2"]

  r1 <- parms["r1"]
  r2 <- parms["r2"]
  alpha11 <- parms["alpha11"]
  alpha12 <- parms["alpha12"]
  alpha21 <- parms["alpha21"]
  alpha22 <- parms["alpha22"]
  K1 <- parms["K1"]
  K2 <- parms["K2"]

  dn1_dt <- r1 * n1 * (1 - (alpha11 * n1 + alpha12 * n2) / K1)
  dn2_dt <- r2 * n2 * (1 - (alpha22 * n2 + alpha21 * n1) / K2)

  list(c(dn1_dt, dn2_dt))
}

# Parameters for stable limit cycle
parms <- c(
  r1 = 1.2,        # Prey intrinsic growth rate
  r2 = 1.2,        # Predator intrinsic growth rate
  K1 = 100,        # Prey carrying capacity
  K2 = 100,         # Predator carrying capacity
  alpha11 = 1,  # Intraspecific competition (prey)
  alpha12 = 1/2,  # Competition of predator on prey
  alpha21 = 1/3, # Competition of prey on predator
  alpha22 = 1   # Intraspecific competition (predator)
)

# Initial conditions
state <- c(n1 = 30, n2 = 20)

# Time sequence
times <- seq(0, 500, by = 0.1)

# Solve ODE
solution <- ode(state, times, lotka_volterra, parms)

# Create two plots
par(mfrow = c(1, 2), mar = c(4, 4, 3, 1))

# Plot 1: Time series
plot(solution[, "time"], solution[, "n1"], type = "l",
     col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.7), lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Time", ylab = "Population size",
     main = "Time series", ylim = c(0, 200))
lines(solution[, "time"], solution[, "n2"],
      col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = c("Species 1 (Prey)", "Species 2 (Predator)"),
       col = c(rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.8), rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.8)),
       lwd = 2, cex = 0.85)

# Plot 2: Phase portrait (limit cycle)
plot(solution[, "n1"], solution[, "n2"], type = "l",
     col = rgb(0, 0.7, 0, 0.7), lwd = 2,
     xlab = "Species 1 (n1)", ylab = "Species 2 (n2)",
     main = "Phase portrait (Limit cycle)")

# Add starting point
points(state["n1"], state["n2"], pch = 16, col = "blue", cex = 1.5)
text(state["n1"], state["n2"], " Start", pos = 2, cex = 0.9)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
